text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating owners/timelines for streaming/chat endpoint reliability fix set (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic).
Maya: TL;DR: we split into infra fixes, client/backoff, and monitoring/alerting.
Alex C.: Can you paste the action list? I lost the doc.
Maya: Sure —
Maya: 1) Infra: increase default gRPC idle timeout + server keepalive tuning. Owner: Jorge. ETA: 2025-11-10. Will run staging load and share numbers.
Jorge: Taking infra. I'll run load tests against staging and post perf numbers. ETA 11/10. If we hit rate-limiter we'll coordinate capacity bump.
Tia: 2) Client SDK: exponential backoff w/ jitter and explicit reconnect on partial response. Owner: Tia. ETA: 2025-10-28. I'll add tests + example in js/python SDK.
Alex C.: For reconnect logic, let's make it opt-in for older SDKs and opt-out default for new minor releases. Also need a compatibility note for customers.
Tia: Good call — default enable on next minor, opt-out env var for now. I'll add migration note and a quick sample.
Maya: 3) Partial response handling: server should return typed partial-status and a restart token so clients can resume cleanly. Owner: SRE (Maya + Jorge). ETA: 2025-11-05.
Jorge: I'll prototype the restart token shape. We should also emit metric streaming.partial_responses.count and streaming.restart_tokens.
Maya: 4) Monitoring: new SLO dashboard + alert when p50+ streaming latency or partial_response rate > 0.5% over 5m. Owner: Alex C. ETA: 2025-10-21.
Alex C.: On it — will add dashboards, an alert runbook, and a pager policy for oncall when partials spike.
Maya: 5) Post-deploy canary: 5% of hostnames route new reconnect logic for 48h, auto-roll back on errors > 0.2%. Owner: Eng Release (Jorge + Release infra). ETA: 2025-11-12.
Jorge: Will coordinate with release team, adding smoke tests and a traffic ramp plan.
Tia: I'll add unit/integration tests for partial response -> reconnect path and a harness to simulate network flaps.
Maya: Recurring patterns observed: 1) client backoffs inconsistent across SDKs; 2) server keepalive defaults too long; 3) lack of structured partial-response signals.
Alex C.: Agree. Short-term mitigation: publish 'avoid partials' guidance for customers and examples for SDK integration. Owner: Product/DevEx.
Maya: Action: weekly check-in on progress every Tuesday 10am PT until all items closed. Owner: Maya.
Jorge: I'll post weekly status updates in #incidents and attach links to PRs/issues.
sre-bot: Deploy note: gateway-keepalive-tuning PR merged by jenkins-bot at 1794990000 :white_check_mark:
Alex C.: Quick Q: who owns the customer communication? We should notify top 10 customers with affected traffic patterns and SLA risk.
Maya: Customer comms: Product -> Tia to draft, Sales to approve. Owner: Tia. ETA: 2025-10-23.
Tia: Will draft today and share in #customer-comm for review.
Alex C.: Thanks. I'll start the dashboard PR and link to this thread (please reference incidents/1795004321 in PR titles).
Maya: Please also tag issues with label "streaming-reliability" and link to the postmortem.
Jorge: Added TODOs to the PM board and set deadlines; will update when load tests finish.
Tia: Put weekly check-ins on my calendar. I'll post progress in the SDK repo too.
Maya: If anyone's blocked, ping me or drop a short blocker msg in this thread. :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing note: keep all PRs/issues linked to 'incidents/1795004321' for traceability and audits.
Alex C.: +1, thanks everyone.
Maya: End of thread.
